movies.summary: "Good Will Hunting" is a drama film about a young janitor at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Will Hunting, who possesses extraordinary mathematical abilities. Despite his genius, Will struggles with personal issues stemming from a troubled past. After assaulting a police officer, he avoids jail time by attending therapy sessions, where he works through his emotional struggles with the help of a compassionate psychologist, Sean Maguire. The film explores themes of love, friendship, and the journey toward self-discovery and healing.

movies.title: Goodbye June
movies.summary: "Goodbye June" is a poignant film that explores themes of loss, nostalgia, and the bittersweet passage of time. Set against the backdrop of the changing seasons, the story follows a character reflecting on their memories and relationships during the month of June, evoking a sense of longing and acceptance as they say goodbye to the past and embrace new beginnings.

movies.title: Goodfellas
movies.summary: "Goodfellas" is a 1990 film directed by Martin Scorsese that chronicles the rise and fall of Henry Hill, a young man who becomes involved in the mob life. The film explores themes of loyalty, crime, and the allure of the gangster lifestyle, showcasing Henry's journey from a petty criminal to a key figure in organized crime. As he navigates the violent world of the Mafia, the consequences of his choices ultimately lead to his downfall and the disintegration of his relationships.

movies.title: Goodrich
movies.summary: The movie "Goodrich" released in 2024 follows the journey of a determined individual navigating the complexities of life and relationships. It explores themes of resilience and personal growth as the protagonist faces various challenges, ultimately leading to a transformative experience. The narrative captivates audiences with its emotional depth and relatable characters, making it a compelling watch.

movies.title: Gran Torino
movies.summary: "Gran Torino" is a 2008 film directed by Clint Eastwood, who also stars as Walt Kowalski, a grizzled Korean War veteran. The story follows Walt as he grapples with his prejudices and the changing neighborhood around him, particularly his relationship with a Hmong family next door. After a young boy named Thao attempts to steal his prized Gran Torino as part of a gang initiation, Walt reluctantly becomes a mentor to him, leading to a journey of redemption and understanding as he confronts his own biases and the complexities of cultural differences.

movies.title: Gravity
movies.summary: "Gravity" is a 2013 science fiction thriller directed by Alfonso Cuarón, centering on two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and veteran astronaut Matt Kowalsky, who are left stranded in space after their shuttle is destroyed. As they struggle to survive, they face the harsh realities of isolation and the vastness of space, battling both physical and psychological challenges. The film highlights themes of resilience and the human spirit's will to survive against overwhelming odds.

movies.title: Green And Gold
movies.summary: "Green And Gold" is a movie released in 2025 that explores themes of hope and resilience. It follows the journey of characters navigating the complexities of their lives while striving to find balance and harmony amidst challenges. The film emphasizes the importance of personal growth and the connections we build with others, ultimately showcasing the beauty of life's ups and downs.

movies.title: Green Book
movies.summary: "Green Book" is a 2018 film that tells the true story of an unlikely friendship between African American classical pianist Don Shirley and his Italian American driver Tony Lip during a concert tour through the racially segregated southern United States in the 1960s. The film explores themes of racism, acceptance, and the transformative power of friendship as the two men navigate the challenges of their journey together.

movies.title: Groundhog Day
movies.summary: "Groundhog Day" is a 1993 comedy film that follows Phil Connors, a cynical television weatherman, who finds himself reliving the same day—February 2nd—over and over again while covering the annual Groundhog Day event in Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania. As he navigates this bizarre time loop, Phil undergoes a transformation, learning valuable life lessons about love, kindness, and the importance of living in the moment.

movies.title: Hacksaw Ridge
movies.summary: "Hacksaw Ridge" is a biographical war film that tells the true story of Desmond Doss, a conscientious objector who served as a medic during World War II. Despite his refusal to carry a weapon due to his religious beliefs, Doss saved numerous soldiers during the brutal Battle of Okinawa, demonstrating extraordinary bravery and conviction. The film explores themes of faith, courage, and the moral dilemmas faced in wartime.

movies.title: Half Nelson
movies.summary: "Half Nelson" is a 2006 film that follows the story of a high school history teacher, Dan Dunne, who struggles with drug addiction while trying to inspire his students. Set in a challenging urban environment, the film explores themes of personal struggle, redemption, and the complexities of teacher-student relationships, particularly through Dunne's bond with a student who discovers his secret. The film highlights the impact of addiction on both personal and professional lives, as well as the challenges of making a difference in the lives of young people.

movies.title: Hamnet
movies.summary: "Hamnet" is a poignant film that explores the life and tragic death of Hamnet, the son of renowned playwright William Shakespeare. Set in the late 16th century, the story delves into the profound impact of loss on Shakespeare's life and work, particularly how Hamnet's passing influences the creation of his iconic play, "Hamlet." Through a blend of historical context and emotional depth, the film examines themes of grief, family, and the enduring power of art.

movies.title: Hannah And Her Sisters
movies.summary: "Hannah and Her Sisters" is a 1986 film directed by Woody Allen that explores the complex relationships and emotional entanglements of three sisters, Hannah, Lee, and Holly, over the course of two years. The story weaves together themes of love, infidelity, and personal growth, showcasing how each sister navigates her own challenges while influencing one another's lives. Set against the backdrop of New York City, the film combines humor and drama, highlighting the intricacies of family dynamics and the search for happiness.

movies.title: Hard Eight
movies.summary: "Hard Eight" is a 1996 film that follows the story of a seasoned gambler, Sydney, who takes a young man named John under his wing. As John navigates the world of gambling, he becomes entangled in a web of deceit and betrayal, ultimately leading to a series of dramatic events that challenge his morality and survival instincts. The film explores themes of mentorship, trust, and the darker side of human nature within the high-stakes gambling scene.

movies.title: Heat
movies.summary: "Heat" is a 1995 crime thriller directed by Michael Mann, centered around the intense cat-and-mouse game between a professional thief, Neil McCauley, and a dedicated LAPD detective, Vincent Hanna. The film explores themes of loyalty, ambition, and the personal costs of their respective pursuits, culminating in a gripping climax during a meticulously planned heist and subsequent confrontation. Its ensemble cast, including Al Pacino and Robert De Niro, delivers powerful performances that highlight the psychological tension between the characters.

movies.title: Hector and the Search for Happiness
movies.summary: "Hector and the Search for Happiness" is a 2014 film that follows Hector, a psychiatrist who embarks on a global journey to discover the true nature of happiness. Frustrated by his inability to help his patients find joy, he visits various cultures and meets diverse individuals, each offering insights into what it means to be happy. Through his experiences, Hector learns valuable lessons about love, friendship, and the simple joys of life, ultimately leading him to a deeper understanding of himself and what happiness truly entails.

movies.title: Hedda
movies.summary: "Hedda" is a film that delves into the complex psyche of its titular character, Hedda Gabler, as she navigates the constraints of her societal role and struggles with her desires for freedom and power. Set against a backdrop of societal expectations, the movie highlights her manipulation and the consequences of her actions on those around her, ultimately exploring themes of ambition, identity, and the search for autonomy.

movies.title: Her
movies.summary: "Her" is a science fiction romantic drama that explores the evolving relationship between a man named Theodore and an advanced operating system named Samantha, which is designed to learn and adapt. Set in a near-future world, the film delves into themes of love, loneliness, and the complexities of human relationships in a technology-driven society, ultimately questioning the nature of connection and intimacy in an increasingly digital age.

movies.title: Here
movies.summary: The movie "Here" explores themes of connection and existential reflection, taking viewers on a journey through various perspectives and experiences. It delves into the lives of characters who navigate their personal struggles and relationships, ultimately leading to a deeper understanding of their place in the world.

movies.title: Heretic
movies.summary: "Heretic" is a 2024 movie that explores themes of belief, faith, and the consequences of challenging societal norms. Through a gripping narrative, it delves into the life of a protagonist who questions established doctrines, leading to conflicts with authority figures and personal turmoil. As the character navigates a world fraught with tension and moral dilemmas, the film prompts viewers to reflect on their own beliefs and the nature of truth.

movies.title: Hero
movies.summary: "Hero" is a visually stunning martial arts film set in ancient China, where a nameless warrior is summoned by the king to recount his story of defeating three notorious assassins. Through a series of flashbacks, the film explores themes of honor, sacrifice, and the nature of truth, ultimately revealing the complexities of loyalty and the consequences of one's actions. With breathtaking cinematography and elaborate fight choreography, "Hero" emphasizes the beauty of martial arts while delving into profound philosophical questions.

movies.title: High Fidelity
movies.summary: "High Fidelity" is a film that follows Rob Gordon, a record store owner in Chicago who struggles with relationships and the meaning of love. After his girlfriend leaves him, he embarks on a journey of self-discovery, revisiting his past relationships and reflecting on his choices. The movie blends humor and introspection, exploring themes of heartbreak, nostalgia, and the significance of music in shaping personal identity.

movies.title: Hill
movies.summary: The movie "Hill" (2025) explores themes of resilience and personal growth as it follows the journey of its protagonist overcoming various challenges in their life. Set against the backdrop of a metaphorical hill, the narrative delves into the emotional and physical obstacles that shape their character, ultimately leading to a profound transformation.

movies.title: Hitch
movies.summary: "Hitch" is a romantic comedy that follows Alex "Hitch" Hitchens, a professional dating consultant, who helps men win over the women of their dreams. However, when he falls for a journalist named Sara, he finds himself struggling to apply his own advice while keeping his true identity a secret. The film explores themes of love, self-discovery, and the complexities of modern dating, blending humor with heartfelt moments.

movies.title: Hitman Hart - Wrestling with Shadows
movies.summary: "Hitman Hart - Wrestling with Shadows" is a documentary film released in 1998 that delves into the life and career of professional wrestler Bret "Hitman" Hart. It offers an intimate look at Hart's experiences in the wrestling world, highlighting his triumphs and struggles, including the behind-the-scenes politics of the sport. The film captures the emotional and physical toll of being a top performer and provides insights into Hart's perspective on the wrestling industry during a tumultuous time in its history.

movies.title: Homestead
movies.summary: "Homestead" is a movie that explores themes of self-sufficiency, resilience, and the journey of individuals or families as they adapt to life in a rural setting. The narrative typically follows their struggles and triumphs as they learn to cultivate the land, build their homes, and foster a sense of community while facing both external challenges and personal growth.

movies.title: Hoosiers
movies.summary: "Hoosiers" is a sports drama film that tells the inspiring true story of a small-town Indiana high school basketball team that rises to prominence under the guidance of a troubled coach. Set in the 1950s, the film explores themes of redemption, teamwork, and the pursuit of dreams as the team battles adversity on their way to the state championship, capturing the passion and spirit of small-town America.

movies.title: Hope Springs
movies.summary: "Hope Springs" is a romantic comedy-drama that follows a long-married couple, Kay and Arnold, who decide to attend a week-long couples' therapy retreat in a small town to rekindle their love and address longstanding issues in their relationship. As they navigate the challenges of therapy, they confront their emotional struggles, rediscover intimacy, and learn valuable lessons about love, communication, and the importance of working together to strengthen their bond.

movies.title: Hunting Season
movies.summary: "Hunting Season" is a gripping film set in 2025 that explores the intense dynamics of a hunting competition. As participants navigate the challenges of the wilderness, the movie delves into themes of survival, competition, and the moral dilemmas faced by those who hunt. With powerful storytelling and stunning visuals, it captures the thrill and dangers of the hunt, leaving audiences on the edge of their seats.

movies.title: I Can Only Imagine
movies.summary: "I Can Only Imagine" is a heartfelt film that tells the inspiring true story of Bart Millard, the lead singer of the Christian band MercyMe. The movie chronicles Bart's difficult childhood, his strained relationship with his father, and his journey of faith that ultimately leads to the creation of the band's iconic song, "I Can Only Imagine." It explores themes of forgiveness, hope, and the transformative power of love and faith.

movies.title: I Care a Lot
movies.summary: "I Care a Lot" is a dark comedy thriller that follows the story of Marla Grayson, a con artist who exploits her position as a legal guardian to manipulate and defraud vulnerable elderly clients. As she targets a wealthy woman, she finds herself in over her head when the woman’s mysterious past and dangerous connections threaten her carefully constructed scheme. The film explores themes of greed, power, and the moral complexities of its characters.

movies.title: I Met A Girl
movies.summary: "I Met A Girl" is a 2020 movie that delves into the life of a man who encounters a mysterious girl that challenges his perceptions of reality and relationships. As their connection deepens, he is compelled to confront his own emotional struggles and the complexities of love. The film explores themes of self-discovery, love, and the impact of meaningful connections on personal growth.

movies.title: Icarus
movies.summary: "Icarus" is a documentary that explores the world of doping in sports, particularly focusing on the use of performance-enhancing drugs. The film follows filmmaker Bryan Fogel as he embarks on a personal experiment to enhance his own athletic performance with steroids. This journey leads him to uncover a shocking scandal involving a Russian doping program at the Olympics, revealing the complexities and ethical dilemmas surrounding the use of drugs in competitive sports.

movies.title: Idiocracy
movies.summary: "Idiocracy" is a satirical science fiction film that explores a dystopian future where society has become overwhelmingly unintelligent due to years of anti-intellectualism and consumerism. The story follows Joe Bauers, an average man who is selected for a hibernation program but is forgotten and wakes up 500 years later. In this future, he discovers that he is the smartest person alive in a world filled with absurdity, ignorance, and incompetence, leading to comedic yet thought-provoking situations that critique contemporary societal trends.

movies.title: If I Had Legs Id Kick You
movies.summary: "If I Had Legs I'd Kick You" is a 2025 film that explores themes of frustration and resilience through the story of a character who, despite feeling immobilized or constrained, seeks empowerment and self-expression. The narrative likely combines humor and introspection, reflecting on personal challenges and the desire to overcome them in a creative and engaging manner.

movies.title: Im Thinking Of Ending Things
movies.summary: "I'm Thinking of Ending Things" is a psychological drama that explores themes of identity, relationships, and existential despair. The film follows a young woman who embarks on a road trip with her boyfriend to meet his parents, but as the journey unfolds, she grapples with her feelings about their relationship. The narrative blurs the lines between reality and imagination, leading to a haunting exploration of the complexities of love and the human psyche.

movies.title: In Search Of Greatness
movies.summary: "In Search Of Greatness" is a documentary film that explores the lives and experiences of some of the world's greatest athletes. Featuring insights from sports legends, it delves into the mindset, training, and unique qualities that enabled these individuals to achieve extraordinary success. The film examines the intersection of talent, hard work, and creativity, providing a deeper understanding of what defines greatness in sports.

movies.title: In The Name Of The Father
movies.summary: "In The Name Of The Father" is a 1993 film that tells the true story of Gerry Conlon, an innocent man wrongly convicted of involvement in the 1974 Guildford pub bombings in the UK. The film explores themes of injustice, the impact of the British legal system, and the fight for truth, as Conlon and his family seek to clear his name and expose the wrongful convictions that led to their suffering.

movies.title: In Waves And War
movies.summary: "In Waves And War" explores the profound impact of conflict on personal relationships and the human spirit. Set against a backdrop of tumultuous events, the film delves into themes of resilience, love, and the struggle for peace as characters navigate the challenges of war while seeking connection and understanding amidst chaos.

movies.title: In Your Eyes
movies.summary: "In Your Eyes" is a 2014 film that explores a unique connection between two individuals, who can see and feel each other’s experiences despite being physically distant. This supernatural bond allows them to communicate and develop a deep emotional connection, navigating the complexities of their lives and relationships. As they learn more about each other, they confront their own fears and desires, ultimately leading to transformative personal growth.

movies.title: Inception
movies.summary: "Inception" is a 2010 science fiction film directed by Christopher Nolan that explores the concept of shared dreaming and the manipulation of the subconscious. The story follows Dom Cobb, a skilled thief who specializes in extracting secrets from people's dreams. He is offered a chance to have his criminal history erased if he can successfully perform "inception," the act of planting an idea into someone's mind without them realizing it. As Cobb assembles a team to navigate the complex layers of dreams, they face challenges that blur the lines between reality and the dream world.

movies.title: Inside Job
movies.summary: "Inside Job" is a documentary that explores the causes and consequences of the 2008 financial crisis. Through interviews with financial insiders, politicians, and journalists, the film reveals the corrupt practices and systemic failures that led to the collapse of major financial institutions, resulting in widespread economic devastation. It critically examines the role of deregulation, financial institutions, and regulatory bodies, providing a comprehensive overview of the crisis's impact on the global economy.

movies.title: Inside Llewyn Davis
movies.summary: "Inside Llewyn Davis" is a 2013 film that follows the life of a struggling folk musician in 1960s New York City. The story captures his challenges as he navigates the music scene, grappling with personal loss and the harsh realities of pursuing his artistic dreams. Through a series of encounters and setbacks, the film explores themes of ambition, resilience, and the search for identity in a rapidly changing cultural landscape.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.summary: "Interstellar" is a science fiction film released in 2014 that explores themes of love, sacrifice, and the survival of humanity. Set in a dystopian future where Earth is facing ecological collapse, it follows a group of astronauts who embark on a journey through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a new habitable planet. The film delves into complex scientific concepts, including time dilation and relativity, while highlighting the emotional bonds between the characters, particularly the relationship between a father and his daughter.

movies.title: Into The Wild
movies.summary: "Into The Wild" is a 2007 film that tells the true story of Christopher McCandless, a young man who abandons his conventional life to embark on a journey into the Alaskan wilderness. Driven by a desire for freedom and self-discovery, he travels across America, meeting various people along the way. The film explores themes of adventure, the quest for meaning, and the profound connection between humans and nature, ultimately leading to McCandless's tragic fate in the wild.

movies.title: IP Man
movies.summary: "Ip Man" is a biographical martial arts film that chronicles the life of Ip Man, a legendary Wing Chun kung fu master. Set in the tumultuous period of the 1930s in China, the film highlights his struggles against Japanese oppression and his journey to uphold the values of martial arts. It showcases his extraordinary fighting skills, his dedication to teaching, and his profound influence on the development of martial arts, ultimately leading to his legacy as the mentor of Bruce Lee.

movies.title: Irresistible
movies.summary: "Irresistible" is a 2020 film that explores the world of political campaigns and grassroots movements. The story follows a retired Marine colonel who becomes involved in a local mayoral race, using his military background to develop a strategy that is both compelling and relatable. The film delves into themes of manipulation, the influence of money in politics, and the complexities of civic engagement, highlighting the often humorous and unpredictable nature of election campaigns.

movies.title: Is This Thing On
movies.summary: The movie "Is This Thing On" explores the challenges and comedic moments of a struggling stand-up comedian as they navigate the ups and downs of the entertainment industry. Through a series of performances and personal encounters, the film delves into themes of self-doubt, perseverance, and the quest for authenticity in a world dominated by social media and instant gratification.

movies.title: It Happened One Night
movies.summary: "It Happened One Night" is a classic romantic comedy that follows the story of a spoiled heiress, Ellie Andrews, who runs away from her controlling father. During her journey, she encounters a cynical reporter, Peter Warne, who sees an opportunity to gain a sensational story. The two characters embark on a series of misadventures that lead to unexpected romance, showcasing themes of love, social class, and the importance of personal growth. Their chemistry and comedic interactions drive the narrative, making it a timeless film.

movies.title: It Was Just an Accident
movies.summary: "It Was Just an Accident" explores the complexities of human relationships and the unforeseen consequences of a seemingly trivial event. The narrative delves into how a single accident can unravel lives, forcing characters to confront their choices, regrets, and the impact of their actions on others. Through emotional turmoil and moments of introspection, the film ultimately highlights themes of forgiveness and redemption.

movies.title: It's a Wonderful Life
movies.summary: "It's a Wonderful Life" is a heartwarming film that follows George Bailey, a man who has dedicated his life to helping others in his small town. On the brink of despair, he contemplates ending his life but is saved by an angel who shows him the impact he has had on those around him. Through this journey, George discovers the true value of life, love, and community, ultimately realizing that his existence has been anything but ordinary.

movies.title: Its Never Over Jeff Buckley
movies.summary: "Its Never Over" is a film that explores the complex life and artistic journey of Jeff Buckley, capturing his rise to fame as a musician and the emotional struggles he faced. Through a combination of music, personal anecdotes, and interviews, the movie delves into Buckley's unique sound and his lasting impact on the music world, ultimately portraying the beauty and tragedy of his brief yet profound career.

movies.title: J Edgar
movies.summary: "J Edgar" is a biographical drama that explores the life and career of J. Edgar Hoover, the controversial first director of the FBI. The film delves into his complex personality, his rise to power, and his impact on American society and law enforcement. It examines his relationships, particularly with his mother and his longtime associate, Clyde Tolson, revealing the personal struggles and secrets that shaped his public persona.

movies.title: Jackie Brown
movies.summary: "Jackie Brown" is a 1997 film directed by Quentin Tarantino, based on Elmore Leonard's novel "Rum Punch." The story follows Jackie Brown, a flight attendant who becomes embroiled in a money smuggling scheme involving a dangerous arms dealer and the law enforcement trying to catch him. As she navigates the treacherous circumstances, Jackie uses her cunning and resourcefulness to outsmart both the criminals and the police, ultimately seeking to secure her own freedom and safety.

movies.title: Jay Kelly
movies.summary: "Jay Kelly" is a movie released in 2025 that explores the life of the titular character, Jay Kelly, as he navigates personal challenges and relationships. The film delves into themes of identity, resilience, and the pursuit of dreams, showcasing Jay's journey of self-discovery and growth against the backdrop of a dynamic world. Through a blend of drama and emotion, it captures the essence of human experience and the importance of connection.

movies.title: Jeremiah Johnson
movies.summary: "Jeremiah Johnson" is a 1972 film that follows the story of a man who leaves civilization to live in the wilderness of the Rocky Mountains. Inspired by true events, Jeremiah seeks to escape the confines of society and find his own path, facing the harsh realities of nature and the challenges of survival. Throughout his journey, he encounters various characters, both helpful and hostile, ultimately exploring themes of resilience, solitude, and the struggle between man and nature.

movies.title: Jerry Maguire
movies.summary: "Jerry Maguire" is a romantic comedy-drama that follows the story of a sports agent, Jerry Maguire, who experiences a moral crisis and decides to write a mission statement advocating for honesty and better personal relationships in sports. After being fired for his views, he starts his own agency with only one loyal football player, Rod Tidwell, and navigates the challenges of rebuilding his career while discovering what truly matters in life and love.

movies.title: Jim & Andy - The Great Beyond
movies.summary: "Jim & Andy - The Great Beyond" is a documentary that explores the behind-the-scenes experience of Jim Carrey during the filming of "Man on the Moon," where he portrayed the late comedian Andy Kaufman. The film delves into Carrey's immersive and transformative approach to embodying Kaufman, showcasing the challenges he faced while blurring the lines between reality and performance. Through a mix of interviews and archival footage, it highlights the impact of Kaufman's unconventional style on comedy and Carrey's own psyche.

movies.title: Jojo Rabbit
movies.summary: "Jojo Rabbit" is a satirical black comedy-drama directed by Taika Waititi, set during World War II. The film follows a young boy named Johannes "Jojo" Betzler, a devoted member of the Hitler Youth, whose beliefs are challenged when he discovers that his mother is hiding a Jewish girl in their home. Through his imaginary friend, Adolf Hitler, Jojo navigates the complexities of ideology, loyalty, and compassion, ultimately leading him to question the values he has been taught.

movies.title: Joker
movies.summary: "Joker" is a psychological thriller that delves into the life of Arthur Fleck, a struggling comedian in Gotham City who faces constant societal rejection and mental health challenges. As he transforms into the infamous villain Joker, the film explores themes of isolation, societal neglect, and the impact of mental illness, ultimately showcasing the dark journey of a man pushed to his limits.

movies.title: Joy
movies.summary: "Joy" is a biographical film that follows the life of Joy Mangano, a struggling single mother who invents the Miracle Mop, a revolutionary cleaning tool. The movie depicts her journey from financial hardship to becoming a successful entrepreneur, highlighting the challenges she faces from her family, the business world, and her own self-doubt. Through determination and resilience, Joy transforms her life and proves that innovation and perseverance can lead to success.

movies.title: Judy
movies.summary: "Judy" is a biographical drama film that depicts the life of iconic singer and actress Judy Garland during the last year of her life. The movie explores her struggles with fame, personal challenges, and the emotional turmoil she faced as she prepared for a series of performances in London in 1968. It highlights her enduring talent and the toll that her career took on her mental health, showcasing her resilience amidst the difficulties.

movies.title: Julie and Julia
movies.summary: "Julie and Julia" is a 2009 film that intertwines the lives of two women: Julia Child, a famed chef who revolutionized French cooking in America, and Julie Powell, a young woman who embarks on a year-long journey to cook all 524 recipes from Child's cookbook. Through their parallel stories, the film explores themes of passion, perseverance, and the impact of food on personal growth and relationships.

movies.title: Julius Caesar
movies.summary: "Julius Caesar" is a cinematic adaptation of William Shakespeare's classic play, depicting the political intrigue and betrayal surrounding the assassination of the Roman leader Julius Caesar. The film explores themes of power, ambition, and the consequences of political actions, as characters navigate the complexities of loyalty and honor in ancient Rome.

movies.title: Junebug
movies.summary: "Junebug" is a 2005 film that explores the complexities of family dynamics and the contrasting lives of its characters. It follows a Chicago art dealer who travels to North Carolina to connect with her husband's family, revealing underlying tensions and emotional struggles. The film delves into themes of love, acceptance, and the challenges of reconciling different backgrounds, showcasing the characters' personal growth amidst their interactions.

movies.title: Juror 2
movies.summary: "Juror 2" is a compelling legal drama that delves into the complexities of a jury's decision-making process. The film follows the story of a juror who grapples with the moral and ethical implications of their vote in a high-stakes trial. As tensions rise and personal biases emerge, the juror must confront their own beliefs and the impact of their choices on the lives of others, ultimately exploring themes of justice, responsibility, and truth.

movies.title: Kajillionaire
movies.summary: "Kajillionaire" is a 2020 film that follows the unconventional life of a young woman named Old Dolio, who has been raised by her eccentric con artist parents. The story explores themes of family dynamics, identity, and the longing for connection as Old Dolio grapples with her upbringing and the impact of her parents' schemes on her sense of self. When a stranger enters their lives, she begins to question her place within the family and what it means to truly belong.

movies.title: Kate & Leopold
movies.summary: "Kate & Leopold" is a romantic comedy that follows the story of Leopold, a charming 19th-century Duke who accidentally travels to modern-day New York City through a time portal. There, he meets Kate, a successful advertising executive. As they navigate the challenges of their vastly different worlds, a heartfelt romance blossoms between them, highlighting themes of love, destiny, and the clash of eras.

movies.title: Knocked Up
movies.summary: "Knocked Up" is a romantic comedy that follows the unexpected consequences of a one-night stand between a slacker named Ben and a successful career woman named Alison. After discovering that she is pregnant, the two must navigate the challenges of their differing lifestyles and the complexities of an unplanned pregnancy, leading to humorous and heartfelt moments as they figure out their relationship and responsibilities.

movies.title: L.A Confidential
movies.summary: "L.A Confidential" is a neo-noir crime film set in 1950s Los Angeles, focusing on three police officers with differing moral compasses as they navigate a web of corruption, scandal, and murder. As they pursue a case involving a series of brutal murders linked to a popular coffee shop, the officers' lives become increasingly intertwined, leading to revelations about the city's dark underbelly and the compromises they make in their quest for justice.

movies.title: La La Land
movies.summary: "La La Land" is a musical romantic drama that follows the love story of an aspiring actress, Mia, and a jazz musician, Sebastian, as they navigate their careers and dreams in Los Angeles. The film explores themes of ambition, love, and the sacrifices one must make to achieve their dreams, all set against a vibrant backdrop of song and dance. It captures the struggle between personal aspirations and romantic relationships, ultimately highlighting the bittersweet nature of pursuing one's passions.

movies.title: Lady Bird
movies.summary: "Lady Bird" is a coming-of-age film that follows the tumultuous relationship between a high school senior, Christine "Lady Bird" McPherson, and her strong-willed mother. Set in Sacramento, California, the story explores themes of identity, family dynamics, and the struggle for independence as Lady Bird navigates her final year of high school, friendships, and romantic relationships while yearning for a life beyond her hometown.

movies.title: Land
movies.summary: "Land" is a poignant drama that explores themes of loss, survival, and self-discovery. The film follows the story of a woman who, after experiencing a profound personal tragedy, retreats into the wilderness to find solace and reconnect with herself. As she navigates the challenges of nature, she learns to confront her grief and ultimately discovers the strength to heal and embrace life again.

movies.title: Last Christmas
movies.summary: "Last Christmas" is a romantic comedy that follows the story of Kate, a young woman who is struggling with her life and making poor decisions. Working as an elf in a Christmas store, she meets Tom, a charming stranger who helps her rediscover joy and meaning in her life. The film explores themes of love, redemption, and the importance of family, all set against the backdrop of the festive holiday season.

movies.title: Last Summer
movies.summary: "Last Summer" is a film that explores the complexities of relationships and personal growth during a pivotal summer. It follows the intertwined lives of several characters as they navigate love, friendship, and the challenges of growing up, ultimately reflecting on the lasting impact of that transformative season. With its emotional depth and relatable themes, the movie captures the essence of youthful experiences and the bittersweet nature of nostalgia.

movies.title: Late Night
movies.summary: "Late Night" is a comedy-drama film that explores the challenges faced by a late-night talk show host, played by Emma Thompson, as she navigates a changing landscape in television and her own career. The story centers around her struggle to revitalize her show with the help of a new writer, played by Mindy Kaling, who brings fresh perspectives and comedic insights. As they work together, they tackle issues of diversity, generational differences, and the evolving dynamics of the entertainment industry.

movies.title: Lawless
movies.summary: "Lawless" is a 2012 film set during the Prohibition era in the 1930s, following the Bondurant brothers who operate a successful moonshine business in Virginia. The story revolves around their fight against corrupt law enforcement and rival gangs, showcasing themes of loyalty, survival, and the harsh realities of rural life. As they face increasing threats to their operation and safety, the brothers must navigate the challenges of their illegal trade while upholding their family honor.

movies.title: Lawrence of Arabia
movies.summary: "Lawrence of Arabia" is a historical epic film that chronicles the life of T.E. Lawrence, a British officer who played a crucial role in the Arab Revolt during World War I. The movie explores his experiences in the Middle East, his complex relationships with various Arab leaders, and the impact of his actions on the political landscape of the region. Through stunning visuals and a powerful narrative, it delves into themes of identity, loyalty, and the consequences of war.

movies.title: Leave No Trace
movies.summary: "Leave No Trace" is a poignant drama that explores the bond between a father and daughter living off the grid in the forests of the Pacific Northwest. When their secluded life is disrupted, they must navigate the challenges of the outside world while trying to maintain their connection and way of life. The film delves into themes of freedom, survival, and the complexities of human relationships in a modern society.

movies.title: Legends of the Fall
movies.summary: "Legends of the Fall" is a 1994 film that tells the story of the Ludlow brothers—Alfred, Tristan, and Samuel—growing up in the early 20th century in Montana. The narrative explores themes of love, loss, and the impact of war, particularly during World War I. As the brothers navigate their complex relationships, especially with the enchanting Susannah, their lives become intertwined with tragedy and betrayal, leading to profound personal transformations and the struggle for redemption.

movies.title: Leon The Professional
movies.summary: "Leon The Professional" is a 1994 film that follows the story of a skilled hitman named Léon, who forms an unlikely bond with a young girl named Mathilda after her family is murdered by corrupt DEA agents. As Léon becomes her protector and mentor, he teaches her the art of assassination while she seeks revenge for her family's death. The film explores themes of loneliness, morality, and the complexities of their unconventional relationship.

movies.title: Let Them All Talk
movies.summary: "Let Them All Talk" is a 2020 film that explores the complexities of friendship, creativity, and the passage of time. The story follows a celebrated author who embarks on a journey with her closest friends on a cruise. As they navigate their relationships, secrets are revealed, and the journey becomes a reflection on their past and the choices they've made, ultimately highlighting the significance of connection and understanding in both life and art.

movies.title: Letters to Juliet
movies.summary: "Letters to Juliet" is a romantic drama that follows a young American woman named Sophie who discovers an unanswered letter to Juliet Capulet in Verona, Italy. Intrigued, she embarks on a journey to find the letter's author, leading her to unexpected adventures, self-discovery, and a chance at love. The film beautifully intertwines themes of love, destiny, and the timelessness of romantic ideals.

movies.title: Life Is Beautiful
movies.summary: "Life Is Beautiful" is a poignant Italian film set during World War II that tells the story of Guido Orefice, a Jewish bookshop owner, who uses his imagination and humor to protect his son from the harsh realities of their internment in a Nazi concentration camp. Through his playful spirit, Guido creates a game to shield his son from the horrors surrounding them, ultimately highlighting the resilience of love and hope in the face of despair.

movies.title: Life Is Sweet
movies.summary: "Life Is Sweet" is a 1990 film that revolves around the challenges and triumphs of a working-class family in London. It explores themes of family dynamics, the ups and downs of everyday life, and the bittersweet nature of human experiences. The narrative weaves together moments of humor and poignancy, showcasing the resilience and warmth of the characters as they navigate their relationships and personal struggles.

movies.title: Life of Pi
movies.summary: "Life of Pi" is a film that follows the extraordinary journey of a young Indian boy named Pi Patel, who survives a shipwreck and finds himself stranded on a lifeboat in the Pacific Ocean with a Bengal tiger named Richard Parker. As they struggle for survival, the film explores themes of faith, resilience, and the power of storytelling, ultimately leading to a profound exploration of the relationship between humans and nature.

movies.title: Life Off Grid
movies.summary: "Life Off Grid" is a documentary that explores the lives of individuals and families who have chosen to live away from traditional urban environments and embrace a self-sufficient lifestyle. It delves into their motivations for going off-grid, the challenges they face, and the rewards of living in harmony with nature. The film showcases various off-grid living techniques, from sustainable farming to renewable energy sources, highlighting the resilience and creativity of those who opt for a simpler life.

movies.title: Like Crazy
movies.summary: "Like Crazy" is a 2011 romantic drama that explores the complexities of love and long-distance relationships. The film follows the story of Jacob and Anna, two college students who fall deeply in love but are separated when Anna overstays her visa in the U.S. Their struggle to maintain their relationship amidst distance, misunderstandings, and the passage of time highlights the challenges of young love and the emotional toll of separation.

movies.title: Limitless
movies.summary: "Limitless" is a 2011 film that explores the life of Eddie Morra, a struggling writer who discovers a mysterious drug that unlocks the full potential of his brain. As he experiences heightened intelligence and productivity, he quickly rises to success. However, the drug's side effects and the dangerous individuals it attracts lead him into a world of chaos, forcing him to confront the consequences of his newfound abilities and the moral dilemmas that come with them.

movies.title: Little Fish
movies.summary: "Little Fish" is a poignant drama that explores the complexities of love and memory in a world affected by a pandemic that erases people's memories. The film follows the story of a young couple, whose relationship is tested as they navigate the challenges of losing their shared past while trying to hold on to their love amidst the chaos. Through beautiful storytelling and emotional depth, it delves into themes of identity, connection, and the fragility of human relationships.

movies.title: Little Miss Sunshine
movies.summary: "Little Miss Sunshine" is a comedic drama that follows the dysfunctional Hoover family as they embark on a cross-country road trip in a VW bus to support their young daughter, Olive, in her quest to compete in a beauty pageant. The journey is filled with unexpected challenges and reveals the family's struggles, dreams, and the importance of togetherness, ultimately showcasing the power of love and acceptance amidst chaos.

movies.title: Little Women
movies.summary: "Little Women" is a 2019 film adaptation of Louisa May Alcott's beloved novel, following the lives of the four March sisters—Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy—as they navigate the challenges of growing up during the Civil War era. The story captures their personal struggles, aspirations, and the bonds of sisterhood, showcasing themes of love, ambition, and the pursuit of happiness in a changing world.

movies.title: Living
movies.summary: "Living" is a poignant exploration of life and the human experience, focusing on themes of existence, personal reflection, and the impact of one's choices. The film delves into the journey of its protagonist as they navigate the complexities of life, ultimately seeking to find meaning and fulfillment in their daily existence. Through heartfelt interactions and moments of introspection, "Living" invites viewers to reflect on their own lives and what it means to truly live.

movies.title: Locke
movies.summary: "Locke" is a 2013 film that follows the story of Ivan Locke, a dedicated construction manager who experiences a life-altering crisis during a drive to a job site. As he navigates a series of phone calls, he must confront personal and professional challenges, including the repercussions of a one-night stand and the impact on his family and career. The film is notable for its real-time approach and minimalistic setting, focusing on Locke's emotional journey and moral dilemmas.

movies.title: Lone Survivor
movies.summary: "Lone Survivor" is a 2013 war film based on the true story of a failed Navy SEAL mission to capture or kill a notorious Taliban leader in Afghanistan. The movie follows a team of four SEALs who find themselves outnumbered and outmatched after being betrayed by a local villager. As they fight for survival against overwhelming odds, the film explores themes of loyalty, sacrifice, and the harsh realities of warfare.

movies.title: Long Shot
movies.summary: "Long Shot" is a romantic comedy that follows the unlikely relationship between a free-spirited journalist, played by Seth Rogen, and a powerful political figure, portrayed by Charlize Theron. When the journalist unexpectedly reconnects with his childhood crush, who is now a presidential candidate, he becomes her speechwriter and helps her navigate the complexities of her campaign. Their chemistry and contrasting lifestyles lead to humorous and heartfelt moments as they challenge each other’s perspectives on life and love.

movies.title: Lost in Translation
movies.summary: "Lost In Translation" is a poignant exploration of loneliness and cultural disconnection, set against the backdrop of Tokyo. It follows the unlikely friendship between Bob Harris, an aging actor, and Charlotte, a young woman, as they navigate their feelings of isolation in a foreign city. Through their shared experiences, they find comfort and understanding in each other, highlighting the complexities of human connection amidst the barriers of language and culture.

movies.title: Love Actually
movies.summary: "Love Actually" is a romantic comedy that intertwines multiple love stories set in London during the holiday season. The film explores various forms of love—romantic, familial, and platonic—through its ensemble cast, showcasing the joys and challenges of relationships. As the characters navigate their personal journeys, the narrative emphasizes the importance of love and connection in all its forms, culminating in heartwarming and sometimes bittersweet moments.

movies.title: Love and Mercy
movies.summary: "Love and Mercy" is a biographical drama that delves into the life of Brian Wilson, the creative genius behind the iconic band The Beach Boys. The film explores his struggles with mental illness, his innovative musical process, and the complex relationships that shaped his life, particularly focusing on his partnership with fellow band member Mike Love and his tumultuous journey towards personal and artistic redemption.

movies.title: Love, Rosie
movies.summary: "Love, Rosie" is a romantic comedy-drama that follows the lifelong friendship between Rosie and Alex, who navigate the complexities of love, life choices, and missed opportunities. Set against the backdrop of their evolving lives, the film explores themes of destiny and the struggles of maintaining a connection despite various obstacles. As they face personal challenges and romantic entanglements, Rosie and Alex must confront their true feelings for each other and decide what it means to be in love.

movies.title: Lucky
movies.summary: "Lucky" is a poignant film that follows the life of a 90-year-old man named Lucky, played by Harry Dean Stanton. As he navigates the challenges of aging, Lucky embarks on a journey of self-discovery in a small desert town. The film beautifully captures themes of existentialism, resilience, and the search for meaning in life, showcasing Lucky's interactions with various quirky characters that help him reflect on his own mortality and the importance of connection.

movies.title: Lullaby
movies.summary: "Lullaby" is a 2022 film that explores the emotional journey of a parent grappling with the challenges of raising a child while facing personal struggles. The narrative delves into themes of love, sacrifice, and the complexities of family dynamics, as the protagonist seeks to find balance and connection amidst life's trials. The film combines poignant storytelling with a soothing, reflective tone, making it a compelling watch for those seeking a heartfelt cinematic experience.

movies.title: Magnolia
movies.summary: "Magnolia" is a 1999 film directed by Paul Thomas Anderson that weaves together multiple storylines set in Los Angeles, exploring themes of chance, connection, and the impact of personal choices. It delves into the lives of a diverse group of characters, including a dying man, a troubled young boy, and a game show host, all of whom intersect in surprising ways. The film is renowned for its intricate narrative structure and emotional depth, highlighting the complexities of human relationships and the struggles of its characters against fate.

movies.title: Malcom X
movies.summary: "Malcolm X" is a biographical film that chronicles the life of the influential African American leader Malcolm X, exploring his journey from a troubled youth to a prominent figure in the civil rights movement. The film delves into his experiences with racism, his conversion to Islam, and his advocacy for Black empowerment and social justice, portraying the complexities of his beliefs and the impact he had on American society.

movies.title: Man Finds Tape
movies.summary: "Man Finds Tape" is a movie released in 2025 that follows the story of a man who discovers an old tape that leads him on a journey of self-discovery and nostalgia. As he delves into the contents of the tape, he uncovers memories and experiences that challenge his present reality, ultimately prompting a reevaluation of his life choices and relationships. The film blends elements of drama and comedy, showcasing the impact of the past on one's present and future.

movies.title: Man On The Moon
movies.summary: "Man On The Moon" is a biographical film that chronicles the life and career of the iconic comedian Andy Kaufman, portrayed by Jim Carrey. The movie explores Kaufman's unconventional and often controversial approach to comedy, his unique performances, and his struggles with fame and identity. Through a mix of humor and poignant moments, it delves into the complexities of Kaufman's character and his impact on the world of entertainment.

movies.title: Man On Wire
movies.summary: "Man On Wire" is a documentary film that chronicles the extraordinary true story of Philippe Petit, a French tightrope walker who, in 1974, performed an illegal high-wire walk between the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center in New York City. The film captures the meticulous planning and execution of this daring feat, exploring themes of ambition, artistry, and the pursuit of dreams against all odds.

movies.title: Manchester By The Sea
movies.summary: "Manchester By The Sea" is a poignant drama that explores themes of loss, grief, and redemption. The film follows Lee Chandler, a withdrawn janitor who returns to his hometown after the death of his brother. As he confronts his painful past and the community he left behind, Lee grapples with the emotional fallout of a tragic family event that continues to haunt him. Through its raw performances and somber storytelling, the movie delves into the complexities of human relationships and the struggle to move forward in the face of overwhelming sorrow.

movies.title: Margin Call
movies.summary: "Margin Call" is a financial thriller that explores the events leading up to the 2008 financial crisis through the lens of a large investment bank. The story unfolds over a 24-hour period, showcasing the moral and ethical dilemmas faced by key personnel as they discover the extent of their firm's risky investments. With mounting pressure to act swiftly, the characters grapple with the consequences of their decisions, illustrating the fragility of the financial system and the human cost of corporate greed.

movies.title: Marlon Williams Nga Ao E Rua - Two Worlds
movies.summary: "Marlon Williams Nga Ao E Rua - Two Worlds" is a 2025 film that explores the intersection of different cultures and identities through the lens of music and storytelling. It delves into the life of Marlon Williams, showcasing his journey as he navigates between two worlds, reflecting on the struggles and beauty of blending his heritage with contemporary influences. The film captures the essence of connection, belonging, and the transformative power of art.

movies.title: Marriage Story
movies.summary: "Marriage Story" is a poignant drama that explores the complexities of love and divorce through the lens of a couple, Charlie and Nicole, as they navigate the emotional and legal challenges of their separation. The film delves into their personal struggles, highlighting the impact of their decisions on their family, particularly their young son. It captures the bittersweet nature of relationships, portraying both the warmth of their shared memories and the pain of their disconnection.

movies.title: Marty Supreme
movies.summary: "Marty Supreme" is a movie set in 2026 that explores the life of Marty, an ordinary man who unexpectedly rises to fame in the culinary world. As he navigates the challenges of celebrity status, he struggles to maintain his authenticity and relationships, ultimately discovering the true meaning of success and happiness. The film blends humor and heartfelt moments, showcasing the pressures of fame while highlighting the importance of staying true to oneself.

movies.title: Mary
movies.summary: The movie "Mary" explores themes of identity and self-discovery, focusing on a woman named Mary who grapples with her past while navigating the complexities of her present life. As she confronts her memories and the choices she has made, the film delves into her relationships and the impact they have on her journey towards understanding herself and finding peace.

movies.title: Mary and Max
movies.summary: "Mary and Max" is a 2009 animated film that tells the poignant story of an unlikely friendship between two characters: Mary, a lonely Australian girl, and Max, a middle-aged man with Asperger's syndrome living in New York. Through a series of letters exchanged over many years, they navigate life's challenges, exploring themes of loneliness, mental health, and the search for connection in a world that often feels isolating. The film combines dark humor with heartfelt moments, ultimately highlighting the significance of friendship and understanding.

movies.title: Master and Commander The Far Side of the World
movies.summary: "Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World" is a historical drama set during the Napoleonic Wars, following Captain Jack Aubrey and his crew aboard the HMS Surprise. Tasked with capturing a formidable French warship, the film explores themes of leadership, camaraderie, and the harsh realities of naval warfare, showcasing the challenges faced at sea and the bond between the captain and his ship's doctor, Stephen Maturin.
